Vendor / paycom pricing

Paycom pricing in 2026

Paycom is strictly quote-only. Buying-committee evidence puts seat-based PEPM at $10-$30 depending on module scope. The Beti self-service payroll model is bundled rather than priced as an upgrade. Implementation fees commonly run $5,000-$25,000 for mid-market deployments. Multi-year contract minimums are standard.

What the buying committee actually pays

Contract minimums and multi-year terms common. SSO is bundled, not surcharged. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

Why is Paycom strictly quote-only?

Paycom's bundled Talent Acquisition + Talent Management + HR Management model is sold by named account executives. Quote-gating supports the sales motion and prevents price comparison from compressing ASP.

What is the typical implementation fee?

$5,000-$25,000 for 100-500 employees on the full suite. Larger deployments scale to $50,000+. Implementation includes data migration, parallel payroll, and admin training.

How does Beti affect total cost?

Beti shifts payroll-error correction from the payroll team to the employee. Customers report reduced admin hours, but the per-employee subscription is not discounted; the savings appear in headcount not subscription.

Does Paycom charge separately for TA, TM, and HRM?

The three pillars are commonly bundled. A la carte is technically possible but rarely quoted because bundle ASP is higher.

What are realistic contract minimums?

3-year terms with annual auto-renewal are standard. Seat minimums are typically 50 for mid-market and 250+ for the enterprise quote.
